name: database-ddl-dml
sql: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS client_matrix; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_matrix.matrix_rows(id INT PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(32)); INSERT INTO client_matrix.matrix_rows(id, label) VALUES (1, 'one') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label=VALUES(label); SELECT id, label FROM client_matrix.matrix_rows ORDER BY id

sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='client_matrix' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
